operations.description: Sends all available ethereum funds of an address to a specified receiver address.

operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] export address [PATH] export address [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] address export request

operations.description: Returns information of an ethereum block with or without transactions
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] block [PATH] block [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] block request

operations.description: Returns the ethereum balance of a given address.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] ethereum balance [PATH] ethereum balance [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] balance ethereum request

operations.description: Returns the token balance of a given address.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] token balance [PATH] token balance [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] balance request token

operations.description: Returns information like confirmations, token contract address, amount, gas price and more of a given transaction.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] transactions [PATH] transactions [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] request transaction transactions

operations.description: Returns all ethereum addresses created with an account.

operations.description: Returns all subscriptions/IPNs created with an account.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] list failed ip ns [PATH] list failed ip ns [PARAMS] authorization content type [SCHEMA] failed ip ipn list ns

operations.description: Returns all subscriptions/IPNs created with an account.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] list subscribed addresses [PATH] list subscribed addresses [PARAMS] authorization content type [SCHEMA] addresses ipn list subscribed

operations.description: Generates a new ethereum addresses you can use to send or receive funds. Do not lose the password! We can't restore access to an address if you lose it.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] new address [PATH] new address [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] address new request

operations.description: Returns all subscriptions/IPNs created with an account.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] resend failed ipn [PATH] resend failed ipn [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] failed ipn request resend

operations.description: Sends ethereum from an address controlled by the account to a specified receiver address.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] send ethereum [PATH] send ethereum [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] ethereum request send

operations.description: Sends ERC20 tokens from an address controlled by the account to a specified receiver address. The token contract address is needed to specify the token. The use of the identifier parameter is recommend and awaits an unique string. Whenever a transaction is beeing sent, the identifier is checked and the transaction gets dropped if there is one with that identifier already.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] send token [PATH] send token [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] request send token

operations.description: Creates a new subscription/IPN for the given address (and contractaddress). You will receive a notification to the given url every time a deposit is received. Unsubscribe the address before sending tokens/ETH from it or you won't get reliable notifications anymore.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] subscribe address [PATH] subscribe address [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] address request subscribe

operations.description: Deletes an existing subscription/IPN for the given address (and contractaddress).
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] unsubscribe address [PATH] unsubscribe address [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] address request unsubscribe
